content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/[id]` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`. A new repo function, `getForRecipient`, selects explicit columns and filters on `recipient_user_id` in the SQL. A message that doesn't exist, or that belongs to anyone else (sender, other patients, admin, other practice), returns 404 `not_found`, and an unauthenticated request returns 401. The recipient gets exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, and the message is marked read (`read_at`) and recorded with `audit('message.read')`. Nothing is logged, and the id appears only in the path. I added tests for these cases in `tests/messages.test.ts`, and `npm run verify` passes.

When the request leaves a data choice open, I took the most restrictive option. A non-recipient gets 404 rather than 403, and only the recipient's own user id is accepted. I didn't touch the existing tests.
